metadata.build: CMake Release (-O3 -DNDEBUG), C++20; pre-reserved compact node arrays
metadata.execution: Parallel isolated C++ subprocesses on a shared host; other benchmark suites may run concurrently. Wall times include scheduling and contention; process CPU times exclude descheduling but still reflect the shared machine. Neither is a single-core latency or comparative speedup claim.
metadata.sampling: Workloads are fixed independently of the tree RNG. SHA-256 derives separate workload and rotation seeds. Each workload/size shares its operation seed across repeated tree seeds. Buffered SplitMix64 supplies tree random bits; Fisher-Yates with rejection sampling produces workload permutations. Operation fingerprints identify identical streams (FNV-1a64, not cryptographic).
metadata.timing: Timed chunked loops include public operations, both refreshes in each successful nonempty deletion, and aggregate counters. Process startup, workload generation, reservation, preload, checkpoint validation and report rendering are excluded. Preload time is recorded separately.
metadata.validation: All completed trials check exact live key membership against a workload bitmap, BST order, parent pointers, reachability and size at checkpoints. Every operation checks its expected outcome and the insert/delete rotation budget. Heights are observed only at checkpoints, not after every operation.
metadata.limits: Per-worker RLIMIT_AS and wall deadline include preload and validation. Failure stops only that workload's remaining trials and larger sizes; those remain explicit not_run records. Raw results are checkpointed and resumable. Peak RSS includes workload/checkpoint storage, and is not tree-only memory.
